title: Adaptive observability bundling with conditional SLA credits & security-questionnaire automation
creator: Asha Patel
description: Run a controlled experiment to offer customers an adaptive observability add-on that dynamically adjusts retention tiers and grants SLA credits when security questionnaire completion is verified. The goal is to increase conversion on enterprise trials, reduce manual sales gating, and quantify revenue uplift while protecting against abuse.
background: Enterprise prospects frequently request longer traces/retention for investigations and premium SLAs; sales and AMs manually negotiate observability retention and SLA credits contingent on security/compliance questionnaire completion. This creates friction, inconsistent entitlements, and operational overhead. We want an experiment where retention tiers are productized as add-ons while conditional SLA credits are automatically applied when a customer completes a predefined security questionnaire and passes basic validation.
hypothesis: If we offer an automated 'Observability Plus' add-on that can be self-attached and ties SLA credits to verified security-questionnaire completion, then more mid-market customers will convert to paid Dedicated/Private contracts and sales time-to-deal will decrease by at least 20%.
experiment_design: Create a new add-on SKU: observability-plus (30/90/365 day retention options, per-tenant pricing tiers).
Implement a gating flow in the Console: customers elect a trial for Observability Plus; the UI surfaces the security questionnaire and highlights required fields for SLA credit eligibility.

Automate questionnaire validation with a lightweight rules engine (answers + attachments). Upon validation, the platform grants a temporary SLA credit token that reduces latency-SLA penalties for 90 days or until purchase.

Run an A/B test: 50% of qualified trial accounts see the self-serve Observability Plus path with automated SLA credit; 50% get the current manual sales-handled flow. Track conversions, time-to-contract, and abuse signals.
Limit the experiment to accounts with monthly usage > $2k and without previous enterprise contract to avoid double-counting renewals.
metrics: Primary: paid-conversion rate to Dedicated/Private within 90 days
Secondary: observability-addon attach rate during trial
Secondary: number of manual sales interactions saved per account
Safety: rate of questionnaire reversals / fraud flags
Operational: number of support tickets related to retention/SLA gating
success_criteria: >= 10% absolute uplift in paid-conversion vs control OR >= 20% reduction in sales time-to-contract
Fraud/reversal rate remains < 1% of qualifying accounts
Net change in support tickets related to gating is neutral or improved
rollout_plan: Phase 0: engineering spike to prototype gating API and questionnaire schema (2 weeks). Phase 1: internal dogfooding with 5 pilot customers and AM feedback (3 weeks). Phase 2: 50/50 A/B rollout to eligible self-serve accounts (8 weeks). Phase 3: evaluate metrics, iterate on questionnaire friction points, and prepare a playbook for sales handoff. Final decision gate at end of Phase 3: scale, iterate, or sunset.
